source_rows.literal: * {{api|t=w|ScriptObject:HookScript|HookScript}}() will now function like {{api|t=w|ScriptObject:SetScript|SetScript}}() if there is no script currently on the object.
source_rows.note: Frame subset only: own native empty-OnShow hook test passes twice with same receiver. Universal ScriptObject and native WoW comparison UNPROVEN.

source_rows.literal: * Both Dropdown menus and the Vehicle Action Bar have been made less susceptible to taint.
source_rows.note: UNPROVEN: less susceptible to taint is qualitative; no specific path, input, before/after security rule or comparison fixture.

source_rows.literal: * Lua closures can now be directly assigned to [[widget script handlers]] from XML using the following new format: <OnClick function="FunctionName"/>. The old format will continue to be supported indefinitely.
source_rows.note: UNPROVEN: direct XML function attribute and indefinite old-format compatibility are literal contracts; fresh parser/binding identity and both-format receipts not run.

source_rows.literal: * Several functions no longer accept unit tokens as parameters, and should now be used in conjunction with UnitName("token") instead. These functions include: {{api|AddFriend}}, {{api|RemoveFriend}}, {{api|SetFriendNotes}}, {{api|AddMute}}, {{api|DelMute}}, {{api|AddIgnore}}, {{api|DelIgnore}}, {{api|InviteUnit}}, {{api|UninviteUnit}}, {{api|GuildInvite}}, {{api|GuildUninvite}}, {{api|GuildPromote}}, {{api|GuildDemote}}, {{api|GuildSetLeaderByName}}, {{api|CalenderEventInvite}}.
source_rows.note: UNPROVEN: fifteen listed APIs exclude unit tokens; fresh name/token rejection, error/return and state transition receipts absent.

source_rows.literal: * The [[SecureHandlers|secure handlers]] system was restricted with respect to OnUpdate/Timer handling and the ability to react to frame visibility. There is a new SetupAnimation method that addresses some of the restrictions. This change unfortunately removed some otherwise useful functionality around auto-hiding frames (and animation) but hopefully a future patch will address this.
source_rows.note: UNPROVEN: secure OnUpdate/timer/visibility restrictions and auto-hide loss need restricted environment and event lifecycle proof; qualitative summary is not an exact restriction table.
